test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Pooja invested a certain sum in a scheme at simple interest of r% per annum for 12.5 years and got interest equal to (3)/(4) of sum invested.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Express the interest as a percentage of the **Principal**: (3/4) × 100 = 75%.

Total interest percentage is the product of **Rate** and **Time** (R × T).

Given **Time** = 12.5 years, so 75% = r × 12.5.

r = 75 ÷ 12.5 = 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Time (T)** = 12.5 years

**Simple Interest (SI)** = 3/4 of **Sum (P)**

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d13bc8638fb02a1b8072323f626e0b8d75fd888403067076dae06b89dc9a6702.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (3/4) × P = (P × r × 12.5) ÷ 100

⇒ 3/4 = (r × 12.5) ÷ 100

⇒ 0.75 = r × 0.125

⇒ r = 0.75 ÷ 0.125

⇒ r = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

**Simple Interest** is calculated only on the initial **Principal** amount throughout the entire period. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Effective Rate of Interest

The total percentage increase in the principal due to interest over a period is given by the product of the **Rate** and **Time** (Effective % = R × T).

Principal and Amount Relationship

The **Amount** (A) is the sum of the Principal (P) and the Simple Interest (SI). A = P + (P × R × T ÷ 100) = P[1 + (RT ÷ 100)].</p
